subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in Column 'A' and Column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) 26th March (i) achieved independence in 1971 through a massive blood-shed war (b) The Pakistani army (ii) did not fight heroically (c) Now, Bangladesh (iii) is the independence and national day of Bangladesh (d) The Bangladeshi people (iv) did something against corruption (e) The supreme and great (v) were safe in the period of leader, Bangabandhu Liberation War Sheikh Mujibur Rahman (vi) killed millions of people in 1971 (vii) is an independent and sovereign country
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (iii) 26th March is the independence and national day of Bangladesh. (b) + (vi) The Pakistani army killed millions of people in 1971. (c) + (vii) Now, Bangladesh is an independent and sovereign country. (d) + (i) The Bangladeshi people achieved independence in 1971 through a massive blood-shed war. First Paper  Solutions (e) + (iv) The supreme and great leader, bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman did something against corruption.
